import pytest
from calendar_core.slots import Event, free_slots, parse_time, overlaps, fmt_duration


def test_issue_unsorted_two_events():
    """Events may arrive in any order and may overlap each other."""
    result = free_slots([Event(720, 780), Event(540, 600)], 480, 1020)
    assert result == [(480, 540), (600, 720), (780, 1020)]  # 8*60=480, 9*60=540, 10*60=600, 12*60=720, 13*60=780, 17*60=1020


def test_issue_overlapping_nested_events():
    """Events may overlap each other, overlapping busy time must merge."""
    result = free_slots([Event(540, 700), Event(600, 650)], 480, 800)
    assert result == [(480, 540), (700, 800)]  # 8*60=480, 9*60=540, 11*60+40=700, 13*60+20=800


def test_issue_clip_start_before_day():
    """Events partly outside the day are clipped to it."""
    result = free_slots([Event(400, 550)], 480, 1020)
    assert result == [(550, 1020)]  # 8*60=480, 9*60+10=550, 17*60=1020; clipped busy [480,550)


def test_issue_clip_end_after_day():
    """Events partly outside the day are clipped to it."""
    result = free_slots([Event(900, 1100)], 480, 1020)
    assert result == [(480, 900)]  # 8*60=480, 15*60=900, 17*60=1020, 18*60+20=1100; clipped busy [900,1020)


def test_issue_ignore_events_entirely_outside():
    """Events entirely outside the day are ignored."""
    result = free_slots([Event(0, 100), Event(1200, 1300)], 480, 1020)
    assert result == [(480, 1020)]  # 8*60=480, 17*60=1020; outsiders 0-100 and 20*60=1200 to 1300 ignored


def test_issue_chain_merge_unsorted():
    """Events may arrive in any order and may overlap each other."""
    result = free_slots([Event(640, 700), Event(500, 620), Event(600, 650)], 480, 800)
    assert result == [(480, 500), (700, 800)]  # 8*60=480, 8*60+20=500, 11*60+40=700, 13*60+20=800; union [500,700)


def test_issue_min_minutes_with_unsorted_overlap():
    """Only gaps of at least min_minutes are returned."""
    result = free_slots([Event(700, 760), Event(540, 600)], 480, 800, min_minutes=50)
    assert result == [(480, 540), (600, 700)]  # gaps 540-480=60, 700-600=100 kept, 800-760=40 dropped <50


def test_contract_back_to_back_no_gap():
    """Back-to-back events (one ends exactly when the next starts) do not overlap."""
    result = free_slots([Event(540, 600), Event(600, 660)], 480, 720)
    assert result == [(480, 540), (660, 720)]  # 8*60=480, 9*60=540, 10*60=600, 11*60=660, 12*60=720; no gap at 600


def test_contract_empty_day_returns_whole_day():
    """free_slots returns the gaps inside [day_start, day_end) not covered by any event."""
    result = free_slots([], 480, 1020)
    assert result == [(480, 1020)]  # 8*60=480, 17*60=1020; empty busy so whole day free


def test_contract_min_minutes_exact_kept():
    """Only gaps of at least min_minutes are returned."""
    result = free_slots([Event(510, 540)], 480, 600, min_minutes=30)
    assert result == [(480, 510), (540, 600)]  # gaps 510-480=30 kept (30>=30), 600-540=60 kept


def test_contract_overlaps_shared_minute():
    """Two events overlap only if they share at least one minute."""
    assert overlaps(Event(540, 600), Event(590, 650)) is True  # share 590-599: 9*60=540, 9*60+50=590, 10*60=600


def test_contract_parse_time_valid():
    """parse_time turns HH:MM (24-hour) into minutes."""
    assert parse_time("09:30") == 570  # 9*60+30=540+30=570


def test_contract_parse_time_invalid():
    """Anything it cannot parse raises ValueError."""
    # no minutes to compute; reference arithmetic 9*60+30=570 for valid case
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse_time("not-a-time")


def test_contract_fmt_duration():
    """fmt_duration renders Xh YYm (e.g. 65 -> 1h 05m)."""
    assert fmt_duration(65) == "1h 05m"  # 65//60=1, 65%60=5 -> "1h 05m"
